summary: Phases 1-8 complete and committed (through dd587065). Phase 7's exhaustive re-derivation completed (274 total, 103 conclusive, 0 disagreements, 3549.99s wall clock, mid-run contention recorded honestly). Phase 8 rebuilt known_conclusive_complexity5.json: conclusive_count unchanged in COUNT (103) but not in SET (7 gained, 7 lost, net zero) -- diffed and explained per-formula; MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS recomputed to the same value (100) with its derivation comment refreshed. Phase 9 is PARTIAL: pass 2 of the final oracle gating suite run (serial, contention-free) is fully green (8/8, 473.76s, including TestGatingConclusiveScan against the new manifest); pinned-artifact audit prints PINNED OK for all three Hard-Constraint artifacts; the anti-collapse guard passes and is confirmed in the gating selection; disagreements==0 held throughout every scan-report-producing run this task performed; the 'well above 38.7%' throughput hypothesis is reported as falsified (103/274, 37.6%, flat pre- to post-fix) -- the fix is justified on soundness grounds only. Pass 1 (parallel, -n 6) had 2 failures: test_mixed_or_diamond_prev was fixed forward (added @pytest.mark.xdist_serial after its widened timeout held in isolation but not under -n 6 contention; verified via collection routing and a standalone re-run at 70.84s) and test_spot_check_individual_countermodels failed on a formula (F5) different from the previously-investigated F9 finding and was NOT independently classified before an explicit 'stop new long-running verification' direction arrived. The full bimodal package suite was also not independently re-run in this final dispatch for the same reason (relying on Phase 6's already-established, fixed-forward-and-confirmed-green result instead). This dispatch also resolved the two Phase-6-carried-forward unclassified oracle tests (test_all_sat_task_relation_ternary, test_all_sat_results_have_complete_output -- both confirmed environmental, pass cleanly in isolation) that were open going into this session.

blockers.description: test_spot_check_individual_countermodels (oracle/bimodal_logic/tests/test_oracle_interface.py::TestSpotCheckCrossSignal) fails under the gating suite's parallel pass (-n 6) on formula F5 (p Since q -> q Until p) at TEMPORAL_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS=180000, a different formula than the F9 finding Phase 6 already investigated and classified. Not independently re-run in isolation, and no PRE_FIX_SHA scratch-swap comparison was performed for F5 specifically -- an explicit 'do not start new long-running verification, close out on the evidence you have' direction arrived mid-investigation. A plausible but unconfirmed hypothesis is the same xdist-contention-inflates-a-near-budget-solve mechanism that test_mixed_or_diamond_prev hit (in which case the same @pytest.mark.xdist_serial fix-forward would likely apply), but this is recorded as a hypothesis, not a conclusion. Next session: re-run in true isolation first; if it still fails, apply the PRE_FIX_SHA scratch-swap methodology used throughout this task before fixing or asserting it clean.

The full bimodal package suite (PYTHONPATH=code/src pytest code/src/model_checker/theory_lib/bimodal/ -v) was not independently re-run as part of this final Phase 9 dispatch, per an explicit 'no new long-running verification' direction. Phase 9's task list calls for this re-run explicitly. Phase 6's result (296 passed, 2 failed then fixed forward via max_time widening, confirmed green at the time) is the most recent evidence available but predates the Phase 7-9 changes in this dispatch (which did not touch bimodal/ source files, only oracle/ test files and data, so a regression from those specific changes is unlikely but not verified). Next session should run this suite once more as a final Phase 9 confirmation.

decisions_made: Phase 2 AMENDMENT: z3.FreshInt causes a severe MBQI performance regression; replaced with _fresh_bound_int() (counter-suffixed z3.Int) at all 14 sites -- same soundness guarantee, no regression.
Phase 5 GATE FIRED: deadness proof found 7 non-zero false_at invocations, all from unit tests calling operator.false_at() directly. Deletion decision flipped to keep-and-fix; no code change needed.

Phase 6/8 follow-up: resolved the two Phase-6-carried-forward unclassified oracle tests (test_all_sat_task_relation_ternary, test_all_sat_results_have_complete_output) -- both confirmed (b) environmental via isolated re-run (28.47s combined, both passed).

Phase 6/8 follow-up: also resolved a third open item recorded in evidence/post-fix-measurements.md but not previously listed as a blocker (test_mixed_or_diamond_prev) -- confirmed (c) genuine large solve-time regression (1.47s pre-fix to ~73s post-fix) via PRE_FIX_SHA scratch-swap comparison, same term-identity-shortcut-loss mechanism as Box(p)->Box(p)/BM_CM_4. Fixed forward.

Phase 7: exhaustive re-derivation completed under mixed load (contention eased partway through); conclusive_count=103 clears the plan's ~95 stop-and-re-run floor, used as-is per the plan's own sanctioned criterion, with the mixed-load condition recorded honestly rather than presented as pristine.

Phase 8: conclusive_count is unchanged in COUNT (103) but not in SET (7 gained, 7 lost). Cross-referenced every changed formula against the pre-fix/post-fix collapse census: none of the 7 losses were 'conclusive-and-wrong' via the aliasing defect -- all are deeply-nested Box/quantified formulas explained by the same term-identity-shortcut-loss mechanism, a genuine solve-time cost not a soundness correction. MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS recomputed to the same value (100) with its derivation comment refreshed to this run's own measurement.

Phase 9: test_mixed_or_diamond_prev's Phase 8 timeout widen (60000->150000) held in isolation but failed under -n 6 parallel contention at exactly the widened budget. Fixed forward using the codebase's own established @pytest.mark.xdist_serial mechanism (moves it to the contention-free serial pass) rather than widening the parallel-pass budget further -- verified via collection routing and a standalone re-run.

Phase 9: an earlier apparent gating-suite failure (98/103 conclusive on TestGatingConclusiveScan) was diagnosed as self-inflicted contention from this dispatch's own concurrently-running background verification jobs, not a real finding -- discarded, and the test re-confirmed green (103/103) once run in true isolation. Recorded to make clear the difference between environmental self-contention and a genuine regression was actively checked, not assumed.

Phase 9: the 'well above 38.7%' throughput hypothesis from the task's original premise is reported as falsified (103/274, 37.6%, identical pre- and post-fix in count though not in set). The fix is recorded as justified on soundness grounds only, not accommodated by any threshold adjustment to manufacture an apparent improvement.

Phase 9: test_spot_check_individual_countermodels/F5 and a final bimodal-package-suite re-run were left unresolved/not performed per an explicit 'stop new long-running verification, close out on the evidence you have' direction -- recorded as explicit blockers, not asserted clean or silently treated as done.
dead_ends: z3.FreshInt was tried first (per the plan) and found unusable in practice due to the MBQI regression -- documented in full in evidence/post-fix-measurements.md rather than silently discarded.
